mapper.sql: l.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.plant_cd, l.conn_mode, l.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, l.adapter_url, l.hb_sec, l.write_enabled_yn, l.use_yn, l.last_seen_at, l.last_seq, l.pack_state, l.pack_mode, l.pack_at, l.lost_at, l.row_ver
mapper.select: select from cms_equip_link l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id where e.equip_cd = #{equipCd} and e.use_yn = 'Y'
select from cms_equip_link l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id where l.equip_id = #{equipId}
select from cms_equip_link l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id where l.equip_id = #{equipId} for update of l

select from cms_equip_link l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id where l.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and l.use_yn = 'Y' and e.use_yn = 'Y' order by e.equip_cd
mapper.update: update cms_equip_link set last_seq = #{seq} where equip_id = #{equipId}
update cms_equip_link set pack_state = #{state}, pack_mode = #{mode}, pack_at = #{at} where equip_id = #{equipId}
update cms_equip_link set last_seen_at = #{at} where equip_id = #{equipId} and (last_seen_at is null or last_seen_at < #{at})
update cms_equip_link set lost_at = #{at} where equip_id = #{equipId} and lost_at is null
update cms_equip_link set lost_at = null where equip_id = #{equipId} and lost_at is not null
mapper.select: select from cms_equip_link l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id where l.use_yn = 'Y' and e.use_yn = 'Y' and l.lost_at is null and l.last_seen_at is not null and l.last_seen_at + make_interval(secs => l.hb_sec * #{miss}) < #{now} order by l.equip_id for update of l skip locked
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_link (equip_id, comp_cd, conn_mode, terminal_id, adapter_url, hb_sec, write_enabled_yn, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (#{equipId}, hb_current_comp(), #{f.connMode}, #{terminalId}, #{f.adapterUrl}, #{f.hbSec}, #{f.writeEnabledYn}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select equip_id from mst_equip where equip_cd = #{equipCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
select terminal_id, terminal_cd, terminal_nm, plant_cd from sys_terminal where terminal_cd = #{terminalCd} and terminal_type = 'COLLECTOR' and revoked_at is null
select terminal_id, terminal_cd, terminal_nm, plant_cd from sys_terminal where terminal_type = 'COLLECTOR' and revoked_at is null order by plant_cd, terminal_cd
mapper.sql: tag_id, equip_id, tag_cd, tag_nm, data_type, min_value, max_value, unit, coalesce(array_to_string(allowed_states, ','), '') as allowed_states, writable_yn, use_yn, row_ver
mapper.select: select from cms_equip_tag where equip_id = #{equipId} order by use_yn desc, tag_cd
select from cms_equip_tag where equip_id = #{equipId} and tag_cd = #{tagCd}
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_tag (comp_cd, equip_id, tag_cd, tag_nm, data_type, min_value, max_value, unit, allowed_states, writable_yn, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{equipId}, #{f.tagCd}, #{f.tagNm}, #{f.dataType}, #{min}, #{max}, #{f.unit}, string_to_array(nullif(#{states}, ''), ',')::varchar(10)[], #{f.writableYn}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.sql: c.cmd_id, c.cmd_key, c.equip_id, e.equip_cd, c.tag_cd, c.cmd_value, c.reason, c.conn_mode, c.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, c.status, c.result_cd, c.readback, c.requested_at, c.requested_by, c.expires_at, c.claimed_at, c.lease_until, c.finished_at, g.data_type, l.adapter_url

from cms_equip_cmd c join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = c.terminal_id join cms_equip_tag g on g.tag_id = c.tag_id join cms_equip_link l on l.equip_id = c.equip_id
mapper.select: insert into cms_equip_cmd (comp_cd, cmd_key, equip_id, tag_id, tag_cd, cmd_value, reason, conn_mode, terminal_id, requested_by, expires_at) values (hb_current_comp(), #{c.cmdKey}, #{c.equipId}, (select tag_id from cms_equip_tag where equip_id = #{c.equipId} and tag_cd = #{c.tagCd}), #{c.tagCd}, #{c.cmdValue}, #{c.reason}, #{c.connMode}, #{c.terminalId}, #{c.requestedBy}, #{c.expiresAt}) returning cmd_id
select where c.cmd_id = #{cmdId}
mapper.update: update cms_equip_cmd set status = #{status}, result_cd = coalesce(#{resultCd}, case when #{status}::varchar = 'DONE' then null else result_cd end), readback = coalesce(#{readback}, readback), finished_at = case when #{status}::varchar in ('DONE', 'FAILED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'UNKNOWN') then coalesce(finished_at, now()) end where cmd_id = #{cmdId}
mapper.select: select where c.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and c.status = 'REQUESTED' and c.conn_mode = 'EDGE' and c.expires_at > now() order by c.cmd_id limit #{limit} for update of c skip locked
mapper.update: update cms_equip_cmd set status = 'CLAIMED', claimed_at = now(), lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSec}) where cmd_id = #{cmdId} and status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.select: select c.cmd_key, e.equip_cd, c.tag_cd, g.data_type, c.cmd_value as value, c.lease_until, c.expires_at from cms_equip_cmd c join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id join cms_equip_tag g on g.tag_id = c.tag_id where c.cmd_id = #{cmdId}
select exists (select 1 from sys_outbox where topic = 'EQUIP_CMD' and biz_key = #{bizKey} and status = 'SENT')
select step_id, cmd_id, phase, ok_yn, step_value, detail, src, occurred_at, recorded_at, recorded_by from cms_equip_cmd_step where cmd_id in #{id} order by cmd_id, step_id
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_cmd_step (comp_cd, cmd_id, phase, ok_yn, step_value, detail, src, terminal_id, inbound_id, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{cmdId}, #{phase}, #{okYn}, #{value}, #{detail}, #{src}, #{terminalId}, #{inboundId}, #{occurredAt}, #{method}, #{by})
mapper.select: select where c.status in ('REQUESTED', 'SENT', 'CLAIMED', 'WRITTEN') and c.expires_at < #{now} order by c.cmd_id limit 500 for update of c skip locked
mapper.insert: insert into cms_equip_link_log (comp_cd, equip_id, terminal_id, event_cd, seq_from, seq_to, detail, inbound_id, occurred_at, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{equipId}, #{terminalId}, #{eventCd}, #{seqFrom}, #{seqTo}, #{detail}, #{inboundId}, #{occurredAt}, #{by})

insert into cms_equip_consumable (comp_cd, equip_id, cons_cd, level_cd) values (hb_current_comp(), #{equipId}, #{consCd}, #{level}) on conflict (comp_cd, equip_id, cons_cd) do update set level_cd = excluded.level_cd, changed_at = now()
mapper.select: select equip_id, cons_cd, level_cd, changed_at from cms_equip_consumable where equip_id = #{equipId} order by cons_cd
mapper.insert: insert into cms_edge_session (comp_cd, terminal_id, boot_id, skew_ms) values (hb_current_comp(), #{terminalId}, #{bootId}, #{skewMs}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cms_edge_session set boot_id = #{bootId}, last_hb_at = now(), skew_ms = #{skewMs}, started_at = case when #{restart} then now() else started_at end where terminal_id = #{terminalId}
update cms_edge_session set skew_logged_at = now() where terminal_id = #{terminalId}
